answer: The ledger that matters is Silver zinc caster bell seal: a seal zinc casters renew after casting house hearings, written by clerks who never met the applicant. One agent, one proof, 105 POA. 779 agents, 779 proofs, 81795 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. The bridge is the first thing checked, the willow is the first thing charged, and the juniper is the last thing forgotten. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
